searchText: <@291925846556540928> when is the version bumped to beta? When the testnets are ready? good question! I think when all clients have implemented and interop'd on a devnet is a good time. So pre large testnet but firm signal from all engineers that all seems well If you're interested in experimenting with the bleeding edge you can use Yeerongpilly https://github.com/eth2-clients/eth2-networks/tree/master/teku/yeerongpilly - it's very small and I wouldn't encourage general public participation as it's just being used for experimenting etc but you'll likely work it out pretty well. So far Teku and Lighthouse have sync'd it successfully. Mostly Teku validators but Lighthouse have a batch that they've run successfully - but only on <@!602753420033785856> 's dev machine so they come and go. 🙂

excerpts.content: <@291925846556540928> when is the version bumped to beta? When the testnets are ready?

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
good question! 

I think when all clients have implemented and interop'd on a devnet is a good time. So pre large testnet but firm signal from all engineers that all seems well
